say:0:1421902001:0.text: Drew, weren't you looking for someone to deal with those Lightbearers?
say:0:1421902001:0.source_cn: 德鲁，你不是想找人和那些耀光人交涉嘛！

say:1:1421902002:0.text: Here comes the perfect person for the role!
say:1:1421902002:0.male: Here comes the perfect person for the role!
say:1:1421902002:0.female: Here comes the perfect person for the role!

say:2:1421903001:1.text: Zanie, is this the person you were talking about? Someone who can teach those Lightbearers a lesson?
say:2:1421903001:1.source_cn: 祖娅，这就是你说的能替我教训那些耀光人的人吗？

say:3:1421903002:1.text: This is <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a Lightbearer envoy. Since this matter involves Lightbearers, you'd better consult with him.
say:3:1421903002:1.source_cn: 这位是从耀光来的特使，<style=stress><p...
say:3:1421903002:1.male: This is <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a Lightbearer envoy. Since this matter involves Lightbearers, you'd better consult with him.
say:3:1421903002:1.female: This is <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a Lightbearer envoy. Since this matter involves Lightbearers, you'd better consult with him.

say:4:1421903003:1.text: What are we waiting for then? Let's knock some sense into them right away!
say:4:1421903003:1.source_cn: 那还等什么，咱们现在就去修理他们一顿。

choice_prompt:5:1421903003.text: What are we waiting for then? Let's knock some sense into them right away!
choice_prompt:5:1421903003.source_cn: 那还等什么，咱们现在就去修理他们一顿。

say:6:1421903004:1.text: Those Lightbearers have slipped into Sal'thorin while things are chaotic here! It's as plain as day they want to take advantage of us while we're down.
say:6:1421903004:1.source_cn: 那些趁着萨洛克兰出乱子来到地底的耀光人！猜都能猜到他们...

say:7:1421903006:1.text: There are remnants of the Ironheart Dominion here! Those Lightbearers have the audacity to tamper with Helthor's temple and pry into my ancestor's relics!
say:7:1421903006:1.source_cn: 但这地底可不只有萨洛克兰，还有我们钢心帝国的遗迹。那些...

say:8:1421903007:1.text: They must be trying to steal something!
say:8:1421903007:1.source_cn: 你说他们不是想当贼还能是什么！

choice_prompt:9:1421903007.text: They must be trying to steal something!
choice_prompt:9:1421903007.source_cn: 你说他们不是想当贼还能是什么！

say:10:1421903008:1.text: Hmph, those Lightbearers decided I was one of them without ever asking what I thought.
say:10:1421903008:1.source_cn: 哼，那是耀光人归的类，他们归类的时候可没问过俺的意见。

say:11:1421903009:1.text: Loosen up, Drew! Maybe they're just some travelers passing through.
say:11:1421903009:1.source_cn: 德鲁，你也别紧张，说不定他们就是来旅行，凑巧路过多停留...

say:12:1421903010:1.text: The relics are on an island in the middle of the lava lake! There's no way they just "happened to" find them!
say:12:1421903010:1.source_cn: 那遗迹可是在熔岩湖中心的岛上！俺是想不出来他们怎么能“...

say:13:1421903011:1.text: One more thing, Zanie—I go by my full name, Drew Ironheart. It's because we've stopped valuing our family names that the younger ones have forgotten the Ironheart Dominion's history.
say:13:1421903011:1.source_cn: 还有祖娅，别叫俺德鲁，叫俺德鲁·铁心，就是因为不重视姓...

say:14:1421903012:1.text: Why are you being so difficult? Guess you're the only one who still cares about your family name now...
say:14:1421903012:1.source_cn: 你麻烦事怎么这么多！不过现在也只有你在讲究这些了……

say:15:1421903013:1.text: Anyway, I'm sure the envoy will address your concerns!
say:15:1421903013:1.source_cn: 总之，相信我们的特使大人会处理好你担心的事的！
say:15:1421903013:1.male: Anyway, I'm sure the envoy will address your concerns!
say:15:1421903013:1.female: Anyway, I'm sure the envoy will address your concerns!

say:17:1421903005:1.text: Who? Those Lightbearer thieves, of course! Ever since Sal'thorin fell into chaos, those Lightbearers have snuck in, trying to take advantage of the situation.
say:17:1421903005:1.source_cn: 教训谁？教训耀光来的贼！自从萨洛克兰出了乱子，那些耀光...

say:0:1421904001:0.text: Oh, my! I think the Lightbearers might have already gone in!
say:0:1421904001:0.source_cn: 不好，他们可能已经进去了！

say:0:1421906001:0.source_cn: 这不是伽利和梅丽莎嘛。

say:1:1421907001:1.text: Magister, hello again! It's been a lucky day for us. See what we've found!
say:1:1421907001:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，又遇到你了！今天可真是幸运！看看我们发现了什么！
say:1:1421907001:1.male: Magister, hello again! It's been a lucky day for us. See what we've found!
say:1:1421907001:1.female: Magister, hello again! It's been a lucky day for us. See what we've found!

say:3:1421907002:1.text: Found what, you thieves? This stele belongs to my ancestor! Wait a minute, you guys know each other?
say:3:1421907002:1.source_cn: 发现了什么？你们两个小贼发现的是俺先祖留下的遗迹！不对...

say:4:1421907003:1.text: Are you two in league with this envoy?!
say:4:1421907003:1.source_cn: 难道你们和这个特使……是一伙的？！
say:4:1421907003:1.male: Are you two in league with this envoy?!
say:4:1421907003:1.female: Are you two in league with this envoy?!

say:6:1421907004:1.text: Oh, Drew! Can you just relax a little? There must be some misunderstanding here, right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:6:1421907004:1.source_cn: 哎呀德鲁，别疑神疑鬼的，肯定是有误会嘛，你说是不是？<...
say:6:1421907004:1.male: Oh, Drew! Can you just relax a little? There must be some misunderstanding here, right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:6:1421907004:1.female: Oh, Drew! Can you just relax a little? There must be some misunderstanding here, right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:7:1421907005:1.text: If you as an envoy, don't deal with these petty thieves, I, Drew Ironheart, will take matters into my own hands!
say:7:1421907005:1.source_cn: 你这个特使要是不处理这两个小贼，俺德鲁·铁心就亲自动手！
say:7:1421907005:1.male: If you as an envoy, don't deal with these petty thieves, I, Drew Ironheart, will take matters into my own hands!
say:7:1421907005:1.female: If you as an envoy, don't deal with these petty thieves, I, Drew Ironheart, will take matters into my own hands!

say:9:1421907006:1.text: Hey, slow your roll! Why does everyone always see us as thieves? Is there any job more dangerous than archaeology?
say:9:1421907006:1.source_cn: 等等！我们怎么又被当成贼了！还有比考古更高危的职业吗！

say:10:1421907007:1.text: We're archaeologists from the Evergreen Conservatory, here to study the ruins of the Ironheart Dominion. We came across this stele and would like to conduct further research...
say:10:1421907007:1.source_cn: 我们是冬青学会的考古学家，在这里考察钢心帝国的遗迹，发...

choice_prompt:11:1421907007.text: We're archaeologists from the Evergreen Conservatory, here to study the ruins of the Ironheart Dominion. We came across this stele and would like to conduct further research...
choice_prompt:11:1421907007.source_cn: 我们是冬青学会的考古学家，在这里考察钢心帝国的遗迹，发现了这块遗迹石碑，想做进一步的考察……

say:12:1421907008:1.text: Archaeologists... Conservatory... Drew Ironheart can't make heads or tails of what you're saying! Anyway, this is a stele from my ancestor, not something for you to be messing with!
say:12:1421907008:1.source_cn: 考察……协会……这些俺德鲁·铁心听不懂，但这是俺矮人先...

say:13:1421907009:1.text: Trust us, we're genuinely interested in the Ironheart Dominion! An empire ruled by gods and dragons, the pinnacle of dwarven civilization, and the mystery behind its sudden collapse—it's truly captivating!
say:13:1421907009:1.source_cn: 当然是因为我们对钢心帝国感兴趣！神明与龙共治的帝国、极...

say:14:1421907010:1.text: Since this stele belongs to your ancestor, you must know that it details an important ritual from the Ironheart Dominion, right? It's an invaluable historical artifact!
say:14:1421907010:1.source_cn: 既然这是你先祖留下的遗迹，你应该知道这石碑上记载着钢心...

say:15:1421907011:1.text: Ritual... Artifact... What does that even mean? Are you saying this stele is a sturdy, durable material?
say:15:1421907011:1.source_cn: ……祭礼……史料……这又是什么意思？是说这石碑是什么结...

say:17:1421907012:1.text: Are you telling me you don't understand the meaning of these inscriptions?
say:17:1421907012:1.source_cn: 你该不会不知道石碑上文字的意思吧？

say:18:1421907013:1.source_cn: 怎、怎么可能不知道！这上面不就写着……

say:19:1421907014:1.text: Alright, I don't understand a thing! I can't read, so what?
say:19:1421907014:1.source_cn: 好吧，俺确实不知道！俺不认字，那又怎么了嘛！

say:20:1421907015:1.text: Aren't you curious about what they mean?
say:20:1421907015:1.source_cn: 你不好奇这上面写的字是什么意思吗？

say:21:1421907016:1.source_cn: 你这么说，我是有点好奇……

say:23:1421907017:1.text: Our job is to share the meaning of these inscriptions and the history they represent with the public. We're not here to steal anything!
say:23:1421907017:1.source_cn: 我们考古学家的工作就是让更多知道这些文字的含义和文字背...

say:24:1421907018:1.text: O—Okay, you're making my head spin here. Just don't take or damage the stele!
say:24:1421907018:1.source_cn: 好、好吧，越说俺的脑子越昏了，总之你们别把俺先祖的石碑...

say:25:1421907019:1.text: I'm glad the air is cleared! This is a chance for you to learn more about your ancestor, Drew! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come take a look. These inscriptions might hold a deeper meaning...
say:25:1421907019:1.source_cn: 误会解开就好！刚好德鲁你也能趁这次机会了解更多先祖的事...
say:25:1421907019:1.male: I'm glad the air is cleared! This is a chance for you to learn more about your ancestor, Drew! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come take a look. These inscriptions might hold a deeper meaning...
say:25:1421907019:1.female: I'm glad the air is cleared! This is a chance for you to learn more about your ancestor, Drew! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come take a look. These inscriptions might hold a deeper meaning...

say:1:1421908001:1.text: "Blessed by the god..." This part must refer to the time when the dwarves had the closest bond with Helthor.
say:1:1421908001:1.source_cn: 深受神明之眷……这指的是赫托与矮人关系最亲密的那段时光吧。

say:2:1421908002:1.text: The dwarves had just mastered the art of forging and magic at that time. It was an era full of ambition, as they watched their great empire take shape...
say:2:1421908002:1.source_cn: 那时的矮人一族刚掌握了锻造技艺与魔力，正是意气风发、见...

say:4:1421908003:1.text: There are few historical records from this period. This stele offers us a rare glimpse into the early history of the Ironheart Dominion!
say:4:1421908003:1.source_cn: 描述这段历史的史料极为稀少，这块石碑可以作为我们了解钢...

say:5:1421908004:1.text: The next part really grabs my attention: "We held a ceremony here... offered our treasured items"... What could that mean?
say:5:1421908004:1.source_cn: 我更在意的是后面的句子，矮人于此作祝日……祭以矮人珍重...

choice_prompt:6:1421908004.text: The next part really grabs my attention: "We held a ceremony here... offered our treasured items"... What could that mean?
choice_prompt:6:1421908004.source_cn: 我更在意的是后面的句子，矮人于此作祝日……祭以矮人珍重物……是什么意思呢？

say:7:1421908005:1.text: Hmm... Could this be referring to the legendary Forgemaster Festival?! To show their gratitude for Helthor's blessing, the dwarves would offer their most cherished possessions...
say:7:1421908005:1.source_cn: 我想想……这难道是传说中的锻魂祭？！矮人为了感念赫托的...

say:8:1421908006:1.text: This festival eventually evolved into the annual Forgemaster Festival we have today! It's a shame that most young dwarves nowadays don't know its origins...
say:8:1421908006:1.source_cn: 锻魂祭后来慢慢演变成了现在一年一度的锻魂大赛！只是现在...

say:10:1421908007:1.text: I think I heard about this ancient festival when I was little... I remember asking the adults why the god would need so much valuable stuff...
say:10:1421908007:1.source_cn: 俺小时候好像听过，是有个古老的祭典会让矮人献上珍贵的宝...

say:11:1421908008:1.text: I believe the festival was more about showcasing one's possessions rather than offering them. Once the festival was over, the items would be returned to their owners.
say:11:1421908008:1.source_cn: 锻魂祭仪式比起“献予”，更像是“展示”或“认证”……祭...

say:13:1421908009:1.text: "Burning liquid flows with fiery grace, forging crystals in their place. Magic washes away the dirt, the secret of craftsmanship is overt..." This part seems to describe a method used to reveal something.
say:13:1421908009:1.source_cn: 奉以熔岩水，奉以锻造晶，魔力荡涤古碑尘，矮人匠心始显形...

choice_prompt:14:1421908009.text: "Burning liquid flows with fiery grace, forging crystals in their place. Magic washes away the dirt, the secret of craftsmanship is overt..." This part seems to describe a method used to reveal something.
choice_prompt:14:1421908009.source_cn: 奉以熔岩水，奉以锻造晶，魔力荡涤古碑尘，矮人匠心始显形……这段碑文的后半部分似乎是在讲使什么东西显形的方法？

say:15:1421908010:1.text: Whoa! My ancestor left me something? So, will I find something if I follow what it says?
say:15:1421908010:1.source_cn: ……！什么！你们是说俺先祖给俺留了宝物？照着这上面说的...

say:16:1421908011:1.text: It's quite possible... But then again, what do "burning liquid" and "forging crystals" refer to?
say:16:1421908011:1.source_cn: 很有可能是这样……那“熔岩水”和“锻造晶”又是指什么呢？

say:17:1421908012:1.text: Lava and ores, obviously. Seems like archaeologists aren't too sharp either.
say:17:1421908012:1.source_cn: 这还不简单！你们这些考古什么家也太孬了，不就是指岩浆和...

say:18:1421908013:1.text: We need to see it from a dwarf's perspective! Legend has it that Helthor once taught the dwarves to forge using a volcano as a furnace and ores as iron... Drew, you nailed it this time!
say:18:1421908013:1.source_cn: 以矮人的思维来说，确实是指这两样东西！毕竟传说中赫托以...

say:19:1421908014:1.text: Let's get moving and find the treasure! Good thing I've been keeping a close watch on the stele all these years—this is my big moment!
say:19:1421908014:1.source_cn: 那还等什么！咱现在就找去！这可是先祖留给俺的宝物！幸亏...

say:20:1421908015:1.text: Again, don't forget to call me Drew Ironheart!
say:20:1421908015:1.source_cn: 还有，别忘了叫俺德鲁·铁心！

choice:14:0:1.text: Could it be about a treasure?
choice:14:0:1.male: Could it be about a treasure?
choice:14:0:1.female: Could it be about a treasure?

choice:14:1:2.text: Could it be a treasure clue?
choice:14:1:2.male: Could it be a treasure clue?
choice:14:1:2.female: Could it be a treasure clue?

say:0:1421909001:0.text: Everything's set! Let's head back for the treasure!
say:0:1421909001:0.source_cn: 东西都齐咯，回去找宝物去！

say:2:1421910001:1.text: Why isn't this working? I hope I didn't get my hopes up for nothing!
say:2:1421910001:1.source_cn: 这怎么没反应啊！不会让俺白高兴一场吧！

say:3:1421910002:1.text: There's a line on the stele that says, "Magic washes away the dirt..." Do we need to enchant the stele? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is your specialty!
say:3:1421910002:1.source_cn: 碑文里还有一句……魔力荡涤古碑尘……难道是要给石碑附魔...
say:3:1421910002:1.male: There's a line on the stele that says, "Magic washes away the dirt..." Do we need to enchant the stele? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is your specialty!
say:3:1421910002:1.female: There's a line on the stele that says, "Magic washes away the dirt..." Do we need to enchant the stele? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is your specialty!

say:4:1421911002:1.text: Are you all frozen or something? Hurry up and follow it!
say:4:1421911002:1.source_cn: 别在这傻站着了，赶紧追呀！

choice:3:0:1.text: The magic seems to be leading us somewhere.
choice:3:0:1.male: The magic seems to be leading us somewhere.
choice:3:0:1.female: The magic seems to be leading us somewhere.

say:0:1421912001:0.text: Move it! Now I see why my elders wanted me to guard the relics!
say:0:1421912001:0.source_cn: 脚步快点！长辈说让俺照看好遗迹，果然没错！

say:0:1421913001:0.text: Zanie, is there a reason Drew insists on using his full name?
say:0:1421913001:0.source_cn: 祖娅，德鲁为什么一直坚持让你叫他的姓呢？
say:0:1421913001:0.male: Zanie, is there a reason Drew insists on using his full name?
say:0:1421913001:0.female: Zanie, is there a reason Drew insists on using his full name?

say:1:1421913002:0.text: Tsk... He just wants to show off. His ancestor was a remarkable craftsman, so it's no surprise they left behind a relic like this...
say:1:1421913002:0.source_cn: 嗐……还不是他好面子！有这样的姓氏说明德鲁的先祖曾经锻...

say:0:1421914001:0.text: This thing dates back to the Age of Gods. Why are you sure it was left by your ancestors?
say:0:1421914001:0.source_cn: 铁心先生！你是怎么确定这处神代年间的遗迹是你先祖留下的？

say:1:1421914002:0.text: My elders told me so... Either way, I'm sure it was meant for me!
say:1:1421914002:0.source_cn: 俺也是听家里长辈说的……但这是留给俺的东西准没错！

say:0:1421915001:0.text: The trail ends here—something's buried beneath!
say:0:1421915001:0.source_cn: 指引在这里停下了，这里埋着东西！
say:0:1421915001:0.male: The trail ends here—something's buried beneath!
say:0:1421915001:0.female: The trail ends here—something's buried beneath!

say:3:1421916001:1.text: W—What does this mean? Is it telling me where my treasure is?
say:3:1421916001:1.source_cn: 这、这是啥意思？是不是讲了俺的宝物在哪？

say:4:1421916002:1.text: This describes the disaster that led to the Ironheart Dominion's downfall! "The dragon's fire reduced the empire to ashes..." How tragic...
say:4:1421916002:1.source_cn: 这描写的是那场使钢心帝国覆灭的灾难！龙息将帝国毁为焦土...

say:5:1421916003:1.text: In a way, the dwarves brought this upon themselves…
say:5:1421916003:1.source_cn: 造成这种后果，某种程度上也是矮人咎由自取……

say:6:1421916004:1.text: I know this part of the history—the Ironheart Dominion fell because our ancestors angered the dragon. But what does this have to do with the treasure?
say:6:1421916004:1.source_cn: 这些事俺也知道一点，钢心帝国不在了，因为俺们的先祖惹怒...

say:7:1421916005:1.text: The fleeing dwarves... Upper level... The mine...

say:8:1421916006:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know what happened after the disaster? A harrowing escape.
say:8:1421916006:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know what happened after the disaster? A harrowing escape.
say:8:1421916006:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know what happened after the disaster? A harrowing escape.

choice_prompt:9:1421916006.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know what happened after the disaster? A harrowing escape.
choice_prompt:9:1421916006.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，你应该知道吧，那场覆灭钢心帝国的灾难……伴随着一场惨烈的逃亡。
choice_prompt:9:1421916006.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know what happened after the disaster? A harrowing escape.
choice_prompt:9:1421916006.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know what happened after the disaster? A harrowing escape.

say:10:1421916007:1.source_cn: ……那些幸存的矮人就是我们的先祖。

say:11:1421916008:1.text: This trail keeps leading us upward... There's a good chance we're following the exact route our ancestors took when they fled.
say:11:1421916008:1.source_cn: 魔力指引着我们一路往上……我怀疑，我们循着的这条道路，...

say:12:1421916009:1.text: So, this journal was probably something left behind by Drew's ancestor during their escape... This makes me feel a bit sad...
say:12:1421916009:1.source_cn: 所以这手札极有可能是当年德鲁的先祖在逃亡过程中遗留下来...

say:13:1421916010:1.text: This belonged to my ancestor? Thank you so much! Without you all, I wouldn't have even understood the writings... I'll keep it safe...
say:13:1421916010:1.source_cn: 这是俺先祖的遗物……谢谢你们，没有你们，俺都不知道先祖...

say:14:1421916011:1.text: But the journal still doesn't explain why the magic trail led us here...
say:14:1421916011:1.source_cn: 但手札还是没有解释为什么找那件珍重之物会找到这里……

say:15:1421916012:1.text: I saw words like "upper level" and "mine." in the journal. Our ancestors must have headed upward during their escape. We might find something in the mine above!
say:15:1421916012:1.source_cn: 这里面还提到了上层、矿洞这些词，如果先祖们要逃亡，一定...

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 大部分矮人失去了生命

say:1:1421918001:1.text: Here's another journal... In this one, Drew's ancestor repents for succumbing to greed and losing sight of the true spirit of craftsmanship...
say:1:1421918001:1.source_cn: 这里有另一份手札……这份手札上，德鲁的先祖在反省自己因...

say:2:1421918002:1.text: Now, it's safe to infer that the dwarves carried many of their creations with them when they fled. Drew's ancestor also took their most cherished work from beneath the stele...
say:2:1421918002:1.source_cn: 根据手札提供的信息能推断，矮人在逃亡时携带了很多锻造的...

say:3:1421918003:1.text: That explains why the magic trail led us here!
say:3:1421918003:1.source_cn: 这就解释了为什么我们沿着锻魂祭石碑的指引找到了这里！

say:4:1421918004:1.text: During the escape, Drew's ancestor must have been forced to discard his works, including their most beloved maiden piece...
say:4:1421918004:1.source_cn: 但在逃亡中，他不得不将那些作品一件件丢弃，直到最后一件...

say:6:1421918005:1.text: Hearing this breaks my heart... My ancestor must have been devastated... I never knew they went through so much back then...
say:6:1421918005:1.source_cn: 俺听着好难过……这对一个矮人来说是多残忍的事……原来先...

say:7:1421918006:1.text: That piece was probably lost along with the rest in the disaster.
say:7:1421918006:1.source_cn: 那件作品估计也和其他作品一样，在灾难中荡然无存了吧。

choice_prompt:8:1421918006.text: That piece was probably lost along with the rest in the disaster.
choice_prompt:8:1421918006.source_cn: 那件作品估计也和其他作品一样，在灾难中荡然无存了吧。

say:9:1421918007:2.text: This is... a box! It's locked with some runes on it... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this one's all yours!
say:9:1421918007:2.source_cn: 这是……一个匣子！被锁住了，上面这些魔法符文……交给<...
say:9:1421918007:2.male: This is... a box! It's locked with some runes on it... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this one's all yours!
say:9:1421918007:2.female: This is... a box! It's locked with some runes on it... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this one's all yours!

say:3:1421919001:1.text: The box is open! There's something inside...

say:5:1421919002:0.text: A... small hammer? There seems to be nothing special about it.
say:5:1421919002:0.source_cn: 是……一把小锤子？看样子就是普通的小铁锤……

say:6:1421919003:1.text: Is this... the treasure my ancestor left me?
say:6:1421919003:1.source_cn: 先祖留给俺的宝物……是这把小铁锤……

say:8:1421919004:0.source_cn: 德鲁是不是大失所望了？

say:9:1421919005:1.text: No, I'm not... Actually, I haven't felt like myself ever since I found out about the treasure...
say:9:1421919005:1.source_cn: 不，俺不失望……自从俺知道有宝物，俺就变得不像俺了……

say:10:1421919006:1.text: This must be the first hammer my ancestor ever used for forging. It's their way of reminding me not to forget the spirit of craftsmanship...
say:10:1421919006:1.source_cn: 这是先祖锻造的第一把锤子，先祖这是在告诉俺，别忘了锻造...

say:11:1421919007:1.text: They want me to always remember the joy of forging... That's the real treasure...
say:11:1421919007:1.source_cn: 它告诉俺，最重要的根本不是宝物，而是最开始锻造时的快乐……

say:12:1421919008:1.text: While I'm in this for personal gain, you guys are helping just to uncover what really happened all those years ago...
say:12:1421919008:1.source_cn: 俺找宝物是因为有利可图，但你们帮我，却是为了知道当年究...

say:13:1421919009:1.text: I've been watching over my ancestor's relics for so many years, yet in the end, I only discovered their true legacy with your help... I feel ashamed.
say:13:1421919009:1.source_cn: 俺照看了这么多年先祖的遗迹，最后却是通过你们才知道先祖...

say:14:1421919010:1.text: I think I'm starting to understand the meaning of archaeology...
say:14:1421919010:1.source_cn: 你们说的考古的意思，俺慢慢的有点知道了……

say:15:1421919011:1.text: Could you archaeologists do me a favor? I'd love for more people to know my ancestor's story, the meaning behind their words, and the hammer they used...
say:15:1421919011:1.source_cn: 考古学家，俺有一个请求，能不能让更多人知道俺先祖的事，...

say:16:1421919012:1.text: No problem! Telling the stories behind artifacts is what we do!
say:16:1421919012:1.source_cn: 当然！这就是我们一直在做的工作——让更多人知道这些文物...

say:17:1421919013:1.text: We might need to take your ancestor's relics back for further research. Would you be willing to lend them to us?
say:17:1421919013:1.source_cn: 不过如果要对这些文物做更细致的研究的话，可能需要把它们...

say:18:1421919014:1.text: Sure thing! You'll make much better use of them than I ever could!
say:18:1421919014:1.source_cn: 俺愿意！它们在你们手上比在我手上能发挥的作用大多了！

say:19:1421919015:1.source_cn: 德鲁，我真要对你刮目相看了！

say:20:1421919016:1.text: Hee-hee, I'm proud of myself too! I can finally live up to my family name!
say:20:1421919016:1.source_cn: 俺现在觉得腰板都直了，俺真正配的上德鲁·铁心这个名字了！
